title: the stick's public key verifies what the stick carries, or the release build is refused
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's tests on int/r1plus1 3390bf74 with throwaway keys and the stand-in docker of test_release_bundle.py; no real release was built.

findings.claim: make_bundle.sh wrote no .sha256.sig and never checked that the public key it puts on the stick verifies the manifest and the bootstrap's .sig; it derived that key from --key, so a release signed with one key could not be held to the key the boxes trust
the launcher, the bootstrap and RUNBOOK section 1 do not check the new .sha256.sig: the stick carries it, but a site does not yet verify the sidecar's signature before trusting its lines
the model pack (--model-pack-out) and its .sha256 are written outside the pending folder and are not covered by the stick key check
